However, its acceptance is more cautious in some European countries, where there are concerns about its environmental impact and the push towards excessive consumerism. This reflects a growing awareness and a call for more sustainable consumption practices. Emerging markets are also engaging with Black Friday, drawn by the economic benefits, though this interest is increasingly balanced with discussions on sustainable growth.
